dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Galugarin ang pagkakasunod-sunod ng tahi, mga kulay ng sinulid, jumps, trims, at mga utos ng makina bago ang produksyon. I-preview ang disenyo nang paisa-isang tahi, lumipat ng mga estilo ng rendering, at i-export ang iyong nakikita.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.
dialog.about.tagline.translation: Interaktibong simulation ng burda, inspeksyon, at pag-export.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Hawakan ang ruler sa screen at i-drag ang slider hanggang ang bar sa ibaba ay eksaktong 100 mm ang haba, pagkatapos pindutin ang OK.

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard
dialog.export.copy.tooltip.translation: Kopyahin ang full-resolution na imahe sa clipboard

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file
dialog.export.save.tooltip.translation: I-save ang imahe sa isang file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Ang wika ay naitakda sa {language}. I-restart ang InkSim ngayon para mailapat ito?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Gagamitin ang default na wika ng system. I-restart ang InkSim ngayon para mailapat ito?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: Ang lahat ng bukas na window ng InkSim ay isasara at muling bubuksan ang kasalukuyang file.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_error.translation: Nabigo ang proseso ng pag-preview ng tahi: {error}

dialog.open_browser.conversion_failed.translation: Nabigo ang pag-export ng CSV ng Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.
dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.translation: Tingnan ang output.err para sa mga detalye ng error.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_timeout.translation: Nag-time out ang preview ng tahi.

dialog.open_browser.converting.translation: Isinasagawa ang pag-export ng CSV ng Ink/Stitch...

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: Buksan ang SVG na ito sa bagong window ng Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.
dialog.open_browser.empty.translation: Walang suportadong file sa folder na ito.

dialog.open_browser.file_read_failed.translation: Hindi mabasa ang file na ito: {error}

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: I-double-click ang folder para makita ang mga file nito.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: I-double-click ang folder para makita ang mga file nito.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Kailangan ang Inkscape para mag-edit ng mga SVG file.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured Ink/Stitch installation and Python launcher are required.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Kailangan ang naka-configure na instalasyon ng Ink/Stitch at Python launcher.

dialog.open_browser.invalid_folder.translation: Hindi ma-access ang folder na ito.

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Gumawa ng datos ng tahi mula sa SVG na ito gamit ang Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Hindi mapatakbo ang aktibong Ink/Stitch script o ang naka-configure nitong Python launcher.

dialog.open_browser.read_failed.translation: Hindi mabasa ang folder na ito: {error}

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Extension ng Ink/Stitch: hindi masuri. Gamitin ang Tools... para subukan ulit.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Extension ng Ink/Stitch: hindi makita sa mga extension directory ng Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Extension ng Ink/Stitch: hindi masusuri hangga't hindi naka-configure ang Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Extension ng Ink/Stitch: hindi pa nasusuri. Gamitin ang Tools... para suriin.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: Pinagmulan ng SVG. Kailangan ang Inkscape para sa preview ng tahi.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: Pinagmulan ng SVG. Piliin ang I-preview para gumawa ng data ng tahi gamit ang Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: Masyadong malaki ang SVG na ito para i-preview dito.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Hindi makagawa ng pansamantalang preview file: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Hindi mabubuksan sa InkSim ang ganitong uri ng file.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}
integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.translation: Hindi na-save ang status ng extension ng Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.
integration.inkscape.inksim_none.translation: Walang nakitang folder ng extension ng InkSim.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.translation: Hindi masuri ang mga folder ng extension ng Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions.translation: I-install / I-update ang mga extension ng InkSim

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Hindi ma-install ang mga extension ng InkSim para sa Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Na-install o na-update ang mga extension ng InkSim para sa Inkscape sa {path}. I-restart ang Inkscape para ma-load ang mga ito.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.
integration.inkscape.not_found.translation: Hindi makita ang Inkscape sa system path.

integration.inkscape.preferences_read_fa.translation: Hindi mabasa ang mga preference ng Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.preferences_write_f.translation: Hindi ma-update ang mga preference ng Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}
integration.inkscape.probe_failed.translation: Hindi mabasa ang mga directory ng extension ng Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.probing.translation: Naghihintay ng tugon mula sa Inkscape…

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: I-restart ang Inkscape para magamit ang bagong Python interpreter.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Alisin ang mga lumang kopya ng InkSim

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Hindi maalis ang lumang folder ng extension ng InkSim: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Naalis na ang mga lumang folder ng extension ng InkSim. I-restart ang Inkscape para i-refresh ang listahan ng mga extension nito.

integration.inkscape.report.active_inkst.translation: Na-update ang aktibong instalasyon ng Ink/Stitch: {path}

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.translation: Hindi na-save ang configuration ng InkSim: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Na-save sa configuration ng InkSim ang natukoy na setup.

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.translation: Hindi masuri ang mga folder ng extension ng InkSim: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.
integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.translation: Hindi makita ang kinakailangang launcher na '{command}'; hindi binago ang preference.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Hindi makita ang Inkscape. Piliin ang executable nito para suriin ang setup.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences.translation: Sinuri ang mga preference ng Inkscape: {path}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Hindi masuri o ma-update ang Python interpreter: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Hindi nasuri ang preference ng Python interpreter dahil hindi available ang directory ng user extensions.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: I-restart ang Inkscape para magamit ang na-update na interpreter.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.
integration.inkscape.report.timeout.translation: Hindi tumugon ang Inkscape sa loob ng {seconds} segundo.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Pumili ng Inkscape executable para suriin.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Hindi tumugon ang Inkscape sa loob ng {seconds} segundo. Maaaring hinaharangan ang komunikasyon ng isa pang instance ng Inkscape o ng isang extension. Isara ang iba pang instance ng Inkscape o i-disable ang extension na humaharang, pagkatapos ay subukan ulit.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Hindi makita ang kinakailangang launcher na '{command}'. Ikaw mismo ang mag-install ng uvr gamit ang `uv tool install uvr`, pagkatapos ay patakbuhin ulit ang configuration na ito. Hindi ito i-i-install ng InkSim.

menu.file.quit_all.translation: Tapusin ang lahat ng window at server

menu.view.clear_snap.translation: I-clear ang naka-save na snap position

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: Walang file ng burda na naka-load para i-export.

message.no_file_to_save.translation: Walang file ng burda na naka-load.

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors
status.line_settings.reset.translation: I-reset ang line width at shading factors

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: I-click para i-adjust ang dark factor, light factor at line width

status.mode.background.translation: I-cycle ang background: itim, puti, naka-configure

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)
status.mode.bottom_view.translation: Bottom view (iguhit ang mga huling stitch sa ilalim ng mga nauna)

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: I-cycle ang jump display: off, lahat, risky lang

status.needle.reset.translation: I-reset ang mga setting ng karayom

status.needle.settings.translation: Mga setting ng crosshair ng karayom
